Last year, Apple launched a brand-new feature for Apple Music called AutoMix. With this year's iOS 27, this feature receives a major upgrade, delivering smoother song transitions than ever before.

AutoMix in Apple Music on iOS 27

Quick recap: AutoMix uses AI technology to create DJ-like transitions between songs in Apple Music. Apple says the original version employed techniques like "time stretching and beat matching" to achieve seamless transitions.

While AutoMix in iOS 26 was already quite impressive, its transition styles were mostly similar and predictable.

Apple says AutoMix in iOS 27 "brings new energy and fun to the experience, taking transitions to a whole new level and pulling listeners in even more."

Having tried it firsthand, I can confirm Apple isn't exaggerating. The AutoMix transitions are noticeably smoother and more natural than before, much closer to the feel of a real DJ. The default "underwater" sound effects that were common in iOS 26 have largely been replaced with more natural transitions, making the flow between songs much smoother.

AutoMix in iOS 27 also remixes the endings and beginnings of songs, precisely aligning the beats at the transition point. It also loops portions of song endings and beginnings to bridge them together—the overall immersive feel is indeed significantly improved over before.

It's worth mentioning that AutoMix has also arrived on Apple Music for tvOS and HomePod with this year's software update.

9to5Mac's take

AutoMix is a rather divisive feature—loved by some, hated by others. Some people simply dislike the various transition styles it applies, which is completely understandable.

However, personally, I find this feature quite entertaining—especially when playing music at social gatherings and parties.

I really enjoy the way Apple Music switches between songs, particularly the transitions between tracks of completely different styles, which adds a lot of flavor to the listening experience.

iOS 27 is now available to public beta testers and is expected to officially release later this year.

What do you think of AutoMix in Apple Music? Have you noticed the improvements in iOS 27? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
